known_failures.note: Five cases fail on every run, and they are four distinct defects — none is the GROUP BY bug, which #52 fixed. Each deserves its own issue and its own measurement.

always_failing.sales_distinct_regions: DISTINCT omitted: 'List all the regions' -> SELECT region FROM sales_data
always_failing.sales_cheapest_product: returns the measure, not the entity: SELECT MIN(price) instead of the product
always_failing.sales_laptop_units: aggregate omitted: SELECT quantity instead of SUM(quantity)
always_failing.emp_joined_2021: no valid SQL produced at all for a year-range filter

floor_rationale: 80 sits 6 points below the lowest observed round (86.0), matching the ~7-point headroom the previous floor used. The floor detects a regression, not a target: it trips if a whole category collapses, but not on the model's ordinary run-to-run variance. Raise it when a real improvement lands and record what changed.
